recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: corporate AI budgets tightening after the gold rush
game design field manuals circulating through builder circles
clear sixteen-degree morning over the bay
summer wind pushing through golden gate fog gaps
shortcuts on phones triggering distant agents
sunset stretching past eight twenty tonight

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Tap deploy buttons in rhythm as CI pipelines light up — ship each micro-feature before the sunrise timer hits zero on a wireframe rooftop.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: each on-beat deploy adds a glowing window to a dawn skyline
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: BPM climbs and fake deploy buttons appear

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Sort falling expense receipts into burn/keep lanes before the quarterly AI budget meeting ends — consultants, GPUs, and mystery SaaS fees tumble faster each round.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.touch_control: swipe left/right/down to route items to lanes
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: clearing a whole wave triggers a satisfying ledger total recalculation
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: items split mid-fall and decoy categories multiply
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: corporate spreadsheet minimalism, amber caution stripes

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Flip through a pocket game-design field manual — match on-screen dilemmas (clarity vs depth, juice vs noise) by swiping to the right page before the mentor timer runs out.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.touch_control: swipe left/right to pick manual pages
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: each correct page quote unlocks a tiny animated game-feel demo
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: pages shuffle faster and near-duplicate advice appears

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick shortcut tiles onto a phone home screen to spin up parallel agents — wrong order triggers timeout spirals, right combos launch glowing CLI terminals.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: successful agent chain completes a one-line ship task on screen
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: tile physics gets bouncier and dock slots shrink
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: iOS homescreen glass with terminal green accents
